base_method_card.title: Are Transformers Effective for Time Series Forecasting?
base_method_card.target_asset: Exchange-Rate dataset future exchange-rate values for 8 channels
base_method_card.label_definition: Predict the next 96 time steps for all 8 exchange-rate channels from the prior 336-step multivariate input window.
data_requirements: date column plus channels Australia, British, Canada, Switzerland, China, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore
base_method_card.training_protocol: Train DLinear with shared weights (individual=False) on Exchange-Rate using input length 336 and prediction length 96. Seed is fixed to 2021. Optimizer is Adam with learning rate 0.0005. Loss is MSE. Batch size is 8. Defaults include train_epochs=10, patience=3, lradj=type1, use_amp=False. DLinear uses direct multi-step forecasting.
base_method_card.evaluation_protocol: Chronological split from Dataset_Custom: num_train=int(len(df_raw)*0.7), num_test=int(len(df_raw)*0.2), num_vali=len(df_raw)-num_train-num_test. Borders are [0, num_train-seq_len, len(df_raw)-num_test-seq_len] to [num_train, num_train+num_vali, len(df_raw)]. Test metrics are computed by concatenating all prediction and truth batches, reshaping to (-1, pred_len, channels), and aggregating MSE and MAE over all test windows, prediction steps, and channels.
strict_requirements: Use DLinear, not DLinear-I; shared weights correspond to individual=False.
Use multivariate setting with enc_in=8 and features=M.
Use chronological 70/10/20 style split implemented as num_train=70%, num_test=20%, remainder validation, with seq_len-adjusted borders.
Fit StandardScaler on train data only.
Use Adam optimizer with learning rate 0.0005, batch size 8, MSE loss, seed 2021.
Report MSE and MAE aggregated over all test windows, forecast steps, and channels.
unknowns: device/GPU details for this selected run
whether early stopping was triggered before 10 epochs
exact validation fraction as percentage after integer rounding
